note: Shops (Dave 2026-10-21). An NPC with an entry here can trade: a dialogue effect {"open_shop": true} opens the trade window. stock: items the trader sells (unlimited for now); buys: item kinds the trader will buy from the player, or "all"; title: the window title. Prices come from items.json value (copper) and data/items/coins.json trade. stock_rules: item id -> [most on the shelf, restock per game day]; purse_cap and purse_regen_per_day: the coin the trader can pay out (copper) and how fast it refills (data/items/coins.json trade.stock has the defaults).
